name: sled one leg calf press on leg press
description: A one-leg calf press on a leg press sled using only your toes. It trains each calf separately under a supported load.
instructions: Sit in the leg press with your back against the pad.
Place the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the sled, heel hanging off, and keep the other foot off.
Release the stops with that knee straight but not locked.
Push the sled away by pointing your toes as far as you can.
Lower slowly for a full stretch, finish the reps, then switch legs.
